references.text: The same procedure for thorough investigation of claims of idolatry in Israel, with the requirement to examine and investigate carefully before a verdict is passed.
Judges shall investigate the case thoroughly to establish the truth, following the same principle of careful scrutiny.
The immediate context describes the offense itself - serving other gods - which is the abomination that must be investigated.
Proverbs describe that a case must be examined thoroughly, as required here before judgment is rendered.
Idolatry is described as an 'abomination' (toevah), using the same terminology employed here.
Carved images of gods are called an abomination to the Lord, using the same expression for idolatry.
Jesus refers to the principle of hearing a person's case and investigating before passing judgment.
